items.prompt: Luxury watch commercial, cinematic macro shot. In near darkness, a thin blade of warm golden light slowly sweeps across the watch dial from left to right, revealing the hands, indices and polished bezel; the reflections on the steel shift naturally as the light moves; the camera dollies slowly forward toward the dial with a subtle parallax. The second hand and the chronograph hands do not change the design of the watch. Keep the watch exactly identical: same dial, same sub-dials, same numbers, same case. Smooth, slow, elegant motion, shallow depth of field. No text, no logo, no people, no hands.

Luxury watch commercial, cinematic shot. The camera makes a slow, deep lateral tracking move from left to right around the watch resting on black volcanic rock, revealing parallax between the rock and the dark background; the beam of warm light slowly moves across the steel case and the leather strap; fine golden dust particles drift and glitter through the beam. Keep the watch exactly identical: same dial, sub-dials, numbers, bezel, case and strap. Smooth, elegant, physically realistic motion. No text, no logo, no people, no hands.

Luxury watch commercial, final hero shot. Slow cinematic push-in toward the watch on a pure black background; the warm golden rim light gradually intensifies and travels along the case edge and the strap, the reflections on the polished steel bloom softly, the glow on the floor grows. Keep the watch exactly identical: same dial, sub-dials, numbers, bezel, case and strap. Keep large empty black space at the top and bottom. Smooth, elegant, majestic motion. No text, no logo, no people, no hands.
